messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: finding files / permissions?
parts:
Hi rflight79,

FILES$file1$tmp_name contains the full path, including temporary
random file name, of your uploaded file.

Jeff

On Fri, Aug 13, 2010 at 8:21 AM, rflight79 <rfli...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi All,
>
> Really liking this project. I have managed to get everything up and
> running, and can run the test provided in the documentation. So I
> wanted to run a simple example of loading a file, reading the file
> into R and then doing some stuff on the data therein.
>
> However, I get an error message that the directory doesn't exist. I am
> running Apache as a regular user (actually using my own userID), and I
> have permissions to create directories and files in /tmp, so I'm not
> sure what is going on. Should I be somehow copying the file somewhere
> else before submitting to the function? From the documentation I
> thought that the directory would exist for the duration of the
> 'rhandler', which seems to me should mean my function should be able
> to access it.
>
> I would appreciate any suggestions as to how to proceed.
>
> Cheers,
>
> -Robert
>
> Function:
>
> summaryOut <- function(FILES){
>        if (!is.null(FILES)){
>
>                fileName <- paste(FILES$file1$tmp_name,FILES$file1$name,sep="/")

>                dt <- matrix(scan(fileName,skip=1), ncol=3)
>
>                meanDT <- apply(dt,2,mean)
>                sdDT <- apply(dt,2,sd)
>                cat('mean ', meanDT, '<br>')
>                cat('sd ', sdDT, '<br>')
>        }
>        else {
>                cat('No file entered!')
>        }
> }
>
> setContentType("text/html")
>
> cat('<HTML><head></head><BODY> ')
> cat('<H1>Robert test for rapache</H1> ')
> cat('<form enctype=multipart/form-data method=POST action="?called=1">
> ')
> cat('Upload a file: <input type=file name=file1><br> ')
> cat('<input type=submit name=Submit> ')
> cat('</form>')
> cat('<br><br> ')
> summaryOut(FILES)
> cat('</body></HTML>')
>
> DONE
>
> Test Data, contained in file test.dat (simple text file)
>  X1     X2    X3

>
> Error Message:

>
> In addition:
> RApache Warning/Error!!!

> Warning message:
> RApache Warning/Error!!!
>
> In file(file, "r") : cannot open file '/tmp/apreqHTiiQI/test.dat': Not
> a directory

messages.author: c60bcb6df5eb5536
messages.subject: Re: finding files / permissions?
parts:
Aha, that was my misunderstanding. $tmp_name is the actual full path
to the temporary file that was created from $name that was read in.
Now that makes so much more sense, and my test script works.

Thank you for the info Jeff.

-Robert
